description: This file contains utility functions and logic for managing AWS EC2 instances, including listing running instances, determining idle instances based on launch time, and stopping instances while logging the events. It is part of a backend service for managing EC2 server lifecycle.

classes.name: EC2Instance
classes.description: Data schema representing an EC2 instance, including id, state, type, launch time, region, and tags.

classes.name: ShutdownLog
classes.description: Database model for logging shutdown events of EC2 instances.

methods.name: List[EC2Instance] list_running_instances(settings: Settings, session_boto, region: str | None = None)
methods.description: Lists all running EC2 instances in the specified region.

methods.name: List[EC2Instance] determine_idle_instances(instances: Iterable[EC2Instance], idle_threshold_minutes: int)
methods.description: Identifies instances that are considered idle based on their launch_time and the specified threshold.

methods.name: List[Tuple[EC2Instance,bool,str]] stop_instances_and_log( settings: Settings, session_boto, db: Session, instances: Iterable[EC2Instance], )
methods.description: Stops the given EC2 instances and logs the shutdown event, returning the result for each instance.

ctags.name: list_running_instances
ctags.pattern: /^def list_running_instances(settings: Settings, session_boto, region: str | None = None) -> List[/
ctags.signature: (settings: Settings, session_boto, region: str | None = None)

ctags.name: stop_instances_and_log
ctags.signature: ( settings: Settings, session_boto, db: Session, instances: Iterable[EC2Instance], )
